rule: The live Catalonia listing belongs in the tier its MANUFACTURER publishes.
reason: Two listings of GDI-6880-02 Elite disagreed: the archived one filed under near-zero-emf, the live one under ultra-low-emf. goldendesignsaunas.com publishes "EMF Under 2MG when sitting 2 to 3 inches from the heating panels" and labels it Near Zero EMF. Our tiers: near-zero 2-3 mG, ultra-low 3-5 mG. Under 2 mG is at or below the near-zero floor and is not ultra-low on any reading. NOTE: the manufacturer page contradicts itself on DISTANCE — under 2MG at 6-8 inches in one spec line and at 2-3 inches in another — but both readings put it in near-zero, so the tier is decided even though the distance is not.

rule: Remove the Catalonia from the tier its manufacturer does not claim.
reason: Consequence of the near-zero ruling above. The product TITLE still reads "Ultra Low EMF" and now contradicts its collection — flagged, not changed, because a title rewrite is copy and needs its own review.
